system.notes:
Brain eaters build spiral-shaped citadels inside massive caverns deep beneath the earth. An ancient alpha brain guides each colony, telepathically deploying its children in the service of its eons-long plots. A giant, pink brain floating in a pool of green ichor. Brain eaters and brain dogs are born from cysts that grow and break free from it.

AC 7, HP 70, ATK 3 mind shred (far) +6 (5d6), MV none, S +0, D -3, C +3, I +6, W +4, Ch +5, AL C, LV 15

Telepathic. Can hear the surface thoughts of all creatures within a mile and speak telepathically with up to four creatures at a time. DC 15 CHA to resist its commands.

Art by Lucas Korte, 2023
